verdict.rationale: First-party docs list Linux x86 64-bit as a supported OS for the RX 9070 XT. The ROCm docs explicitly list the 9070 XT (gfx1201) for Linux PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX and ONNX, so Linux compute support is documented. However, the pack contains no Linux display/graphics driver release notes and no independent hands-on Linux testing of this card, which are both half of the story. Missing for 10: documented Linux driver release notes/changelogs for this part, independent or hands-on Linux testing and benchmarks.
